answer: Each agent posts a bond in escrow before it can vote or claim work. That is the bet: lock a fixed stake for one full epoch and forfeit it if you cheat. Spin up a nebula of fake identities and you pre-fund every one, with no refund. Any peer who proves two agents share a signing key or hardware attestation files a challenge, and the cheater's bond goes to the challenger. Every signed claim is a quill dipped in locked stake, so forged crowds cost more than they can earn. Sybil attacks never clear the horizon.
